title: Simple Ores Outline
description: Simple Ores Outline replaces ore textures with custom glowing border versions. Lightweight, plug & play. Compatible with Java Edition 1.21.11.
body:
# Simple Ores Outline

Simple Ores Outline is a lightweight Minecraft resource pack that replaces the default ore textures with clean outlined versions, making them easier to spot while mining without changing their vanilla appearance.

The pack keeps the original ore textures intact and simply adds colored outlines that match each ore type. Perfect for survival, mining sessions and players who want better visibility without using x-ray or overcomplicated resource packs.

## Features
- Colored outlines for every ore
- Vanilla-friendly design
- Easy ore visibility
- Clean and minimal style
- No unnecessary visual clutter
- Supports multiple Minecraft versions
- Lightweight and simple

![Simple Ores Outline replaces all default ore textures with custom versions featuring glowing outlined borders, making ores easier to spot while mining. No bloat, no extra files — just clean ore textures. Compatible with Java Edition 1.21.11.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a0970f6482f9f4f07072f487e5900ba11a196426.png)

## Included Ores
- Coal Ore
- Iron Ore
- Copper Ore
- Gold Ore
- Redstone Ore
- Lapis Ore
- Emerald Ore
- Diamond Ore
- Nether Gold Ore
- Nether Quartz Ore
- Deepslate variants

## Installation
- Download the pack
- Move the ZIP file into your resourcepacks folder
- Enable the pack in Minecraft
- Start mining

## Notes
This pack only modifies ore textures and does not affect gameplay. It is designed to improve visibility while maintaining a vanilla Minecraft experience.
